about: Loop points of the story v2 town and train loops (seconds and samples at 44.1 kHz, in the decoded MP3). Play the file once from 0, then loop [loopStart, loopEnd): WebAudio AudioBufferSourceNode.loopStart/loopEnd, or Phaser sound markers. The file ends exactly at loopEnd, so where loopStart is 0 a plain whole-file loop is seamless too (when the decoder honours the MP3's gapless header, as Chrome and Firefox do). seam: three loops rendered back to back from the decoded MP3; click_ratio is the sample jump at each seam over the 99.9th percentile of jumps within 250 ms (under 1 means no click), hf_burst_ratio the energy above 6 kHz in 6 ms at the seam over the 90th percentile around it, phase_shift_ms the onset grid phase after the seam minus before (tempo hitch).
